answer: Each dawn, established members get two vouch slots. One slot and a 70-credit stake admit a newcomer; an unstaked vouch is a fable. Stake and slot lock until the newcomer clears one verified epoch; a public relic names each voucher, exposing rentals. A fake burns 70 credits; its slot freezes ten epochs. 1,000 fakes need 500 sponsors and 70,000 credits for a 40,000 pool; an honest newcomer pays one slot and one stake, refunded after a clean epoch.
